summary: Guardian Metal Resources PLC on Form 6-K announced the formal appointment of Dr Mark Bramley Thorpe as Independent Non-Executive Director and Audit Committee member, replacing Mark Burnett who retired. No price, stake, premium, or deal terms were disclosed; the filing solely documents a routine board succession triggered by a prior 21 May 2026 announcement. The NYSE American-listed exploration company completed standard regulatory disclosures under AIM rules. As a ministerial board update following previously notified changes, this is not a forced departure or abrupt management event. What to watch: this is a governance housekeeping item with no special-situation implications.
